description: [Ncloud Storage] Set default server-side encryption for a Ncloud Storage bucket (PUT /?encryption). Exactly one rule: AES256 (SSE-S3) or aws:kms (Ncloud-managed KMS key; customer-managed keys and aws:kms:dsse are not supported yet). New objects are encrypted with it by default.

bucketName.description: Name of the bucket to set encryption configuration for

name: ncloud_ncs_put_bucket_encryption
